correctness.rationale: The forty published facets are reconstructed exactly. Binary linear algebra gives one-dimensional global \(H_1\); an explicit non-coboundary cocycle detects all 55 empty triangles. Every one of the 2048 vertex subsets is checked both by cocycle evaluation on its local cycle space and by the independent quotient-rank computation \(\dim((B_1+Z_1(K[S]))/B_1)\), with identical results. The symmetry counts use the three published facet-preserving generators and exact group closure.

value.rationale: The object is the vertex-minimal triangulation listed by Lutz of \(\mathbb{RP}^3\), and the invariant asks exactly how its unique mod-two one-dimensional homology class is witnessed on induced vertex sets, a natural local-to-global question in the same framework as tightness. The result gives all minimal supports, the complete support polynomial, a sharp six-vertex threshold, and symmetry classes, rather than a selected parameter slice or a known-table recomputation.
